newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ACAN calls on Schiphol for meeting over night ban.
newsitem.headline: ACAN calls on Schiphol for meeting over night ban.

text.p: ACAN, the Air Cargo Carriers Association of the Netherlands, has called on Hans Smits, president of Schiphol Airport, to arrange a meeting for all thosed concerned about the proposed night ban on wide-body aircraft.
ACAN rejects the proposals which will effect DC-10 aircraft and the Boeing 747 in its 100,200, 300 and SP versions from August 1, said Achim van der Graaff, chairman of ACAN.
ACAN members object to the short-notice of the proposed ban.
"We are very concerned about this move and it means that the position of the air cargo industry in the Netherlands is jeopardised."
ACAN represents nearly 50 carriers in the Netherlands wants to have a meeting for all the parties concerned as soon as possible, he stressed.
"The members should have the chance to contribute and then we can solve this problem as soon as possible."
Meanwhile, we have asked our members to tell us if they are effected by the ban in preparation for such a meeting, he added.
